reason: The published FastAPI entrypoint exposes seven GA4 tools backed by defined async Admin/Data API handlers; the realtime offset option has a partial defect.

tools.name: get_account_summaries
tools.description: List all GA4 accounts and properties the user has access to. Call this first to discover property IDs.
tools.behavior: Retrieves and consumes the async account-summary pager, returning all account summaries as proto-field-name dictionaries.

tools.name: get_property_details
tools.description: Returns full details for a specific GA4 property (time zone, currency, industry, etc.).

property_id.description: GA4 property ID — a number (123456789) or 'properties/123456789'

tools.behavior: Normalizes the property resource name and retrieves a property, returning a proto-field-name dictionary.
notes: Implementation normalizes integer/digit-string property IDs or accepts a string starting 'properties/' whose last segment is numeric; other strings raise ValueError. This restriction is not encoded in the exposed schema.

tools.name: list_google_ads_links
tools.description: Lists Google Ads account links for a GA4 property.

property_id.description: GA4 property ID — a number (123456789) or 'properties/123456789'

tools.behavior: Normalizes the property resource name and consumes the Google Ads links pager, returning dictionaries.
notes: Implementation normalizes integer/digit-string property IDs or accepts a string starting 'properties/' whose last segment is numeric; other strings raise ValueError. This restriction is not encoded in the exposed schema.

tools.name: list_property_annotations
tools.description: Returns date annotations for a GA4 property (release notes, campaign launches, traffic anomalies, etc.).

property_id.description: GA4 property ID — a number (123456789) or 'properties/123456789'

tools.behavior: Normalizes the property resource name and consumes the reporting-data annotations pager using the alpha Admin client.
notes: Implementation normalizes integer/digit-string property IDs or accepts a string starting 'properties/' whose last segment is numeric; other strings raise ValueError. This restriction is not encoded in the exposed schema.

tools.name: run_report
tools.description: Run a GA4 Data API report. Examples — top pages: dimensions=['pagePath'], metrics=['screenPageViews','sessions']. Traffic sources: dimensions=['sessionSource','sessionMedium'], metrics=['sessions','conversions']. Countries: dimensions=['country'], metrics=['sessions','newUsers']. Relative dates: '7daysAgo', '30daysAgo', 'yesterday', 'today'. Absolute dates: 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

property_id.description: GA4 property ID — a number (123456789) or 'properties/123456789'

dimension_filter.description: FilterExpression for dimensions (see GA4 Data API docs)

metric_filter.description: FilterExpression for metrics (see GA4 Data API docs)

tools.behavior: Constructs a RunReportRequest from named dimensions and metrics and date-range dictionaries; converts supplied loose filter and ordering dictionaries to protobuf messages, applies pagination/currency/quota parameters, runs the report and serializes the response.
notes: Implementation normalizes integer/digit-string property IDs or accepts a string starting 'properties/' whose last segment is numeric; other strings raise ValueError. This restriction is not encoded in the exposed schema.

Filter objects and ordering items intentionally have no exposed inner properties; the handler passes them to FilterExpression/OrderBy protobuf constructors. return_property_quota defaults to false in the dispatcher, but no schema default is declared.

tools.name: run_realtime_report
tools.description: Run a GA4 realtime report showing live active users. Use realtime dimensions/metrics.

property_id.description: GA4 property ID — a number (123456789) or 'properties/123456789'

tools.behavior: Constructs a RunRealtimeReportRequest from named dimensions and metrics; converts supplied loose filter and ordering dictionaries to protobuf messages, applies limit, offset and quota parameters, calls the realtime reporting method and serializes the response.
notes: Implementation normalizes integer/digit-string property IDs or accepts a string starting 'properties/' whose last segment is numeric; other strings raise ValueError. This restriction is not encoded in the exposed schema.

Filter objects and ordering items intentionally have no exposed inner properties; the handler passes them to FilterExpression/OrderBy protobuf constructors. return_property_quota defaults to false in the dispatcher, but no schema default is declared.

The advertised offset is assigned to RunRealtimeReportRequest.offset when supplied; the GA4 realtime request does not support offset, so this optional argument is a handler defect. No runtime execution was performed.

tools.name: get_custom_dimensions_and_metrics
tools.description: Returns the property's custom dimensions and metrics. Use before run_report to find custom field names.

property_id.description: GA4 property ID — a number (123456789) or 'properties/123456789'

tools.behavior: Fetches property metadata and returns only dimensions and metrics whose custom_definition flag is true.
notes: Implementation normalizes integer/digit-string property IDs or accepts a string starting 'properties/' whose last segment is numeric; other strings raise ValueError. This restriction is not encoded in the exposed schema.
Source review only, no tools/list or live requests.

All seven tools are advertised unconditionally by tools/list, which is permitted without authentication; tools/call requires an authenticated MCP token and Google credentials (server.py:638-711). No configurable tiers or optional tool modules are registered.

The dispatcher has a defined callable src.ga_tools function for each advertised name. It does not validate arguments against inputSchema; missing required keys and protobuf construction errors become JSON-RPC -32603 errors.

OAuth, health, status and SSE endpoints are HTTP routes, not additional MCP tools. src/provider.py is unused by the published server:app entrypoint and registers no tools; its mcp dependency is not listed in requirements.txt, but that unused module is not an entrypoint import blocker.
Deployment requires Google OAuth client configuration and encryption key configuration; no definite published entrypoint import blocker was identified by source inspection.

review.method: Root independently evaluated TOOLS literal AST with shared _PROPERTY_ID dictionary and compared all seven exact schemas/descriptions; traced credentials dispatcher and realtime offset defect.
